title: three-real-world-tests

dependencyPrep.command: Inspect lockfiles and $schema references with rg; no install run.
dependencyPrep.notes: No $schema references or lockfile-backed local schemas were found. Dependency installation would not improve validation fidelity for the discovered pytest files.

Installed root dependencies with scripts suppressed so lerna.json could validate against node_modules/lerna/schemas/lerna-schema.json. npm emitted peer/deprecation warnings only and completed successfully.
dependencyPrep.output: added 2079 packages in 6s; npm reported peer dependency and deprecation warnings, but exit code was 0.

dependencyPrep.command: Inspect lockfiles and $schema references with rg; no install run.
dependencyPrep.notes: No $schema references or package-manager lockfiles indicated local schema dependencies. Existing Go/Node package metadata was sufficient for catalog-backed validation.

repositories.name: pytest
repositories.notes: Mature Python project with pyproject and CI/config surface.

repositories.name: nestjs
repositories.notes: Large TypeScript framework with package, lint, and test configuration.

repositories.name: hugo
repositories.notes: Go static site generator with mixed build and CI configuration.

findings: Build succeeded with go build -o bin/dollarlint ./cmd/dollarlint; validation completed in about 1.14s over 314 discovered files.
Overall result: 257 validated, 56 skipped, 1 failed; 6 issues total (1 parsing, 5 validation), 0 schema issues, 0 coverage issues, 2 warnings.
pytest result: 14 validated and 7 skipped; no issues or warnings observed.

nestjs result: 226 validated and 30 skipped; no file issues observed. The root lerna.json local node_modules schema was available after dependency prep. One CircleCI catalog schema compile warning was reported for .circleci/config.yml.
hugo result: 17 validated, 18 skipped, and 1 error. hugolib/testdata/fakejson.json is a GIF payload with a .json extension, producing the single parsing issue.

hugo validation findings: docs/.github/workflows/markdownlint.yml sets with.globs to null where the GitHub Workflow schema expects a string; docs/package.json uses name hugoDocs, which violates the package.json lowercase-name pattern; docs/hugo.toml produced three Hugo schema additionalProperties findings for module.mounts.sites and outputFormats.*.mediatype.

Two warnings came from SchemaStore CircleCI schema compilation for hugo/.circleci/config.yml and nestjs/.circleci/config.yml; both were correctly treated as warnings/skipped catalog validation rather than file findings.
No DollarLint crash, malformed JSON output, or obvious output-contract regression was observed.

productRecommendations.recommendation: Deduplicate repeated catalog schema compile warnings by schema/source in summary output while preserving per-file detail in JSON.
productRecommendations.rationale: The same CircleCI SchemaStore compile failure appeared for both Hugo and NestJS. Current behavior is correct, but repeated external-schema warnings can distract users during broad corpus sweeps.

productRecommendations.recommendation: Consider an opt-in fixture or binary-content ignore affordance for obvious non-text payloads with config-like extensions under testdata/fixture paths.
productRecommendations.rationale: Hugo includes a GIF file named fakejson.json specifically as test data. Reporting it as invalid JSON is technically correct, so this should remain opt-in and conservative.

productRecommendations.recommendation: Review whether common skipped project config filenames such as jest.json and jest-e2e.json have safe SchemaStore matches worth enabling.
productRecommendations.rationale: NestJS had many skipped Jest-style JSON files. They were not failures, but a targeted catalog-match expansion could improve useful coverage if schemas are reliable.

productDecisions: No product code or configuration changes were made during this sweep.
Keep invalid .json parse failures visible by default; the Hugo fakejson.json case is useful signal unless users opt into ignores.
Keep external catalog schema compile failures classified as warnings, not validation findings.
followUp: If noise reduction becomes a priority, prototype warning deduplication around repeated schemaCatalogSchemaUnavailable entries.
Optionally run a focused catalog-coverage pass on skipped Jest and project-specific config filenames before adding any new filename heuristics.
No immediate blocker was found in pytest, NestJS, or Hugo validation behavior.
